Prompt: A surreal, hyper-realistic photo manipulation of two vibrant hot-pink swans (bubblegum-magenta pink, hex ~ #F542A4 to #FF69B4). Their long necks are elegantly intertwined, crossing over each other to form a heart-like shape. The swans turn their heads away from each other in perfect mirrored symmetry, heads gracefully bowed downward. Each swan has the anatomy of a mute swan: a bright pink beak matching its plumage, the characteristic black facial mask, a black knob at the base of the bill, and small dark eyes. The feathers are richly detailed, soft, and fluffy, fully saturated in intense pink with lighter pink highlights on the breast and body. No white or orange tones appear anywhere on the birds. Their large, rounded bodies overlap and fill the bottom half of the frame, shot close-up from a slightly low angle so the birds dominate the composition.

Background: a moody, painterly deep teal-blue sky (dark petrol blue to turquoise, hex ~ #0E5A73 to #1B7A96), darkest and most saturated at the top and gradually lightening toward the horizon. Soft, wispy white-grey clouds streak horizontally across the middle and lower background. The sky has a textured, brushed, cinematic quality, like a hand-painted or heavily color-graded photograph. A faint dark horizon with a small patch of pale light shows at the very bottom, between the swans' bodies.

Style and mood: dreamlike and romantic, with bold color grading built on a strong pink-against-teal complementary palette. Fine-art photography aesthetic, ultra-sharp feather detail, soft diffused lighting, symmetrical composition, Valentine's love theme.

Color constraints: the swans must be a uniform vivid hot pink (around 
#FF4FA3), and the sky must stay deep teal-blue (around 
#12617E) with soft white clouds. Do not shift the palette.

Negative: no white feathers, no orange beaks, no text, no watermark, no extra birds, no asymmetry.

Remix idea: Try a different animal pair, like flamingos, horses, giraffes, or cats curling their tails into a heart. Recolor the feathers in lavender, chrome silver, or black against a sunset sky.
